objective: Repair the relational composition contract for every device-mediated conversation while preserving the accepted inventory and all unrelated fields.
required_repairs: For scene-emma-errol, scene-taro-errol, scene-taro-ninereeds, scene-emma-ninereeds, and scene-bob-ninereeds: the human and represented mind are the two conversational participants. The human looks toward the phone and holds or positions it naturally toward their own face; the free hand is neutral or conversational, never waving at the viewer. The phone is seen at a three-quarter oblique angle so its identity remains recognizable without being presented to us.

For scene-errol-ninereeds: the two phones are the two conversational participants. Angle the phones and holders slightly inward toward one another; do not face them squarely toward the viewer. Each screen may remain obliquely legible for identity verification.
Add the global pixel rule: characters talk to each other, never perform toward the viewer; correct identity and count cannot compensate for a failed interaction relation.
Add relation_failed and salience_failed alarm conditions for viewer-facing presentation poses or ambiguous conversational orientation.
Preserve the 13 masters, eight crops, usage map, canonical bindings, and all non-device prompts exactly.
Copy prior input bindings and append repair_source and operator_review bindings.
